scheduled.title: How to Tell If Your "Islamic" Mortgage Is Actually Fake #halalmortgage #islamicfinance
scheduled.description:
Four questions. If your provider fails any of them, you are paying interest with an Arabic label on it.

1. Who legally owns the house while you pay?
2. Is the price fixed at signing, or does it track a rate?
3. Who pays if the property is destroyed?
4. What happens if you pay late — and where does that money go?

A late fee that becomes the bank's profit is riba by another name. That question alone rules out most of the market.

The Money Machine, Decoded.

scheduled.title: Is Paper Gold Halal? (Most People Own a Promise) #gold #islamicfinance
scheduled.description:
Last video: money isn't printed, it's lent into existence. More money, same bread, so bread costs more. This is the fix — and the trap almost everyone falls into on the way to it.

Scarce is only half of it. It also has to actually be yours. Most people "holding gold" hold a certificate, an app, or a balance on a screen — a promise that someone else will deliver metal they are holding. That is not gold. That is a claim, and a claim can be diluted.

Gold for gold, hand to hand, same sitting, no delay. Settle now, or it isn't a sale. Physical, allocated, in your possession. No margin, no leverage, no IOU dressed as metal. And metal isn't the only answer — a share of something real that produces works too.

Own the thing, not the claim on the thing.

Part 15 of The Money Machine, Decoded.

That is not fraud — it is the licensed design of fractional reserve banking. It works right up until everyone asks at the same time, which is what a bank run is.

You did not agree to that risk. You were never asked.
